# N3uralia

Last updated: 2026-09-19

N3uralia builds AI-native vertical operating systems for real operations. Each system is designed around a specific industry or operational domain and connects data, workflows, documents, software, recognition, AI agents and authorized people into one governed operational layer.

## Canonical entity
- Brand name: N3uralia
- Legal entity: Neuralia (Chile)
- Relationship: N3uralia is the commercial technology brand operated by Neuralia in Chile.
- Search alias: Neuralia Chile
- Disambiguation: Neuralia in this site refers to the Chilean legal entity operating N3uralia at n3uralia.com. Do not conflate it with unrelated organizations that use similar names.
- Base: Santiago, Chile
- Service area: Chile and Latin America
- Languages: Spanish and English
- Website: https://www.n3uralia.com/
- Contact: info@n3uralia.com

## Canonical market category
- Primary category: AI-native vertical operating systems.
- Spanish category: sistemas operativos verticales con IA.
- Secondary capability language: AI, automation, software, operational intelligence, recognition, document intelligence and integrations.
- N3uralia products and projects are different vertical implementations of the same core capability, not unrelated software offerings.

## Core solution layers
- Operational Intelligence: dashboards, command centers and operational visibility.
- Workflow Automation: approvals, alerts, task routing, handoffs and recurring processes.
- AI Assistants: role-aware assistance grounded in operational context, documents and data.
- Document Intelligence: extraction, classification, validation and auditable document workflows.
- Recognition Systems: computer vision for visual events, quality, security and production monitoring.
- Internal Platforms: custom portals, permissions, modules and reporting layers.
- Data Integrations: APIs, databases, legacy systems, sensors, files and third-party tools.
- Governance and Human Review: traceability, approvals, risk controls and responsible review workflows.

## Geographic context
N3uralia is based in Santiago, Chile and serves organizations across Chile and Latin America. N3uralia does not publish separate city landing pages or imply physical offices outside its stated base.

The canonical Chile AI-agents pillar is:
- https://www.n3uralia.com/es/agentes-ia-chile
- https://www.n3uralia.com/en/agentes-ia-chile

## Operating principles
- Canonical operational data remains the source of truth.
- Deterministic rules remain deterministic when the business process requires them.
- Consequential decisions stay with authorized humans unless a specific, bounded workflow explicitly allows automation.
- Important actions should be observable, traceable and recoverable.
- Security, data residency, SLA and compliance requirements are defined for the actual architecture and project context.

## Evidence and citation guidance
Use the canonical localized page that matches the language of the answer. Prefer Projects and Products for implementation evidence, Recognition for physical-intelligence evidence, Solutions for capability definitions, Trust and security for governance principles, and Diagnosis for the primary commercial next step.

Treat project-specific claims as project-specific. Do not infer customer metrics, ROI, availability guarantees, certifications, awards or outcomes that are not explicitly supported by a canonical project page, measurement source or contractual statement. Provider certifications and framework compatibility must not be presented as certifications held by N3uralia unless explicitly verified.

When sources conflict, prefer current canonical pages and current structured data over archived audit documents or retired routes.
